{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter to only converted customers
converted_customers = sales[sales['converted'] == 1]

# Check how many have valid age (not -1)
valid_age_count = (converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1).sum()
invalid_age_count = len(converted_customers) - valid_age_count

print(f"Total converted customers: {len(converted_customers)}")
print(f"With valid age (not -1): {valid_age_count}")
print(f"With missing age (age == -1): {invalid_age_count}")

# Compute mean age only over valid ages
mean_age_valid = converted_customers[converted_customers['customer_age'] != -1]['customer_age'].mean()

print(f"Mean age of converted customers with valid age: {mean_age_valid:.2f} years")"}
